result.reason: The operative language establishes the preferred mutual cap and required uncapped carve-outs while retaining the mutual consequential-damages exclusion. It also addresses payment obligations, but does so more broadly than required by excluding all Section 5 amounts owed by either party, rather than only Customer payment obligations, and includes revenue-share amounts in the cap calculation. The reference period also runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself. These are limited deviations, but they make the revision less than strictly minimal. Drafting is otherwise professional, aside from the retained punctuation error in the original text.
